design_quote: Study design: randomized control trials (RCTs), case-control studies, or cohort studies published in English.
k_quote: 12 studies, including five RCTs and seven observational cohort studies with a total of 12,682 patients, were included.
reason: Mixed-design review (5 RCTs + 7 cohorts) pooled all designs together; no RCT-only pooled pairwise synthesis is reported.
